files.content: # Checkbox Group > Multi-select checkbox set with shared state and select-all support. This file matches the installed `checkbox-group` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/checkbox-group.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/checkbox-group.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0` ## Registry dependencies - `core` - `track-highlight` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/ui/checkbox-group`: `CheckboxGroup`, `CheckboxGroupItem`, types `CheckboxGroupProps` ## Composition ### Anatomy ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { useState } from "react"; import { Checkbox } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/checkbox"; import { CheckboxGroup, CheckboxGroupItem } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/checkbox-group"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; const ALL_VALUES = ["email", "sms", "push", "slack"]; export function PrimitiveCheckboxGroupExample() { const [value, setValue] = useState(["email", "push"]); const allChecked = value.length === ALL_VALUES.length; const someChecked = value.length > 0 && !allChecked; return ( setValue(checked ? ALL_VALUES : [])} aria-label="Select all channels" /> Select all channels Email Digest and receipts SMS Critical alerts only Push Mobile and desktop Slack Post to #alerts ); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `checkbox-group` - `item`: `data-track-item` - `root`: `data-disabled`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-track` (`hover` | `none`) ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/checkbox-group - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/checkbox-group.json
